pr50.exactBody:
## Why

High-severity advisory [GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h) was published 2026-10-06 15:35Z. It covers `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` >=1.12.0 <1.31.0: the SDK's OAuth client could send credentials to an authorization server chosen by the MCP server. Our lockfile held 1.30.0, so `npm run audit:runtime` and the release gate's `runtime-dependency-audit` step now fail on every branch.

## Change

This is a proposed follow-up, P0-50, filed the same way as P0-49 (proxy-addr).

- `package.json` range: `^1.27.1` to `^1.31.0`.
- Lockfile: 1.30.0 to 1.32.1 (6 lines, no other package changes).
- `docs/NATIVE_MCP.md` names the installed version and says the installed-candidate acceptance ran on 1.30.0.
- Patch changeset.

Stacked on the integration head `9c0835b7` (#46, #47 and #49).

## Test plan

- [x] `npm run audit:runtime`: no known vulnerabilities
- [x] typecheck, build, check:package, check:third-party-notices, check:vendor-links, check:freeze, check:docs-drift
- [x] Parity tests and the MCP tests (7,209 tests across 33 files); `nativeMcpHttp`, `nativeMcpClient`, `reconciliationDefectsMcp` and `reconciliationDefectsMcpHttp` 47/47
- [ ] Full ci.yml plus release:gate on the merged integration (orchestrator)
